sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October. Sandbach arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, establishing a commanding position in the division. Alsager Town sit bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 games and have lost their last five matches, making them heavy underdogs in this fixture.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a challenging away trip to Dawley Town, who are seeking to climb from mid-table; Stafford's recent draw suggests they may be steadying after mixed form. In the title race, third-placed AFC Bridgnorth's recent loss has given Sandbach breathing room, and they host Eccleshall at home—a fixture between two competitive sides with Eccleshall looking to bounce back after their own recent defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community in what appears an even battle. Bilston Town's strong recent form (five wins in six games) continues at home against Foley Meir. Barnton welcome Shawbury United, with Shawbury desperately seeking to end a five-game losing streak. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, with both teams in lower-mid-table and needing results. Brereton Social face Widnes Town in a fixture between two struggling sides, with Widnes winless from 7 games. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a bottom-half clash. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a match between teams fighting relegation form.
